The decree’s WWF range is 6.5–8.5 and its aggregate allowance is 1% of actual WWF discharge duration in the month, also with a sixty-minute excursion cap. Keep location, instrument and denominator separate; neither allowance authorizes a WWF discharge or demonstrates compliant results.
